Native field-generator extensionality extends signed-translation equivariance to the whole original field. The constructed prescribed residue chart and the native Laurent-place theorem yield a genuine j-pole fixed by the actual signed translation stabilizer. Native normalized-generator field operations give only the ratio formula needed for the raised weight-twelve second coordinate; a new general all-weight chart framework is unnecessary.
